name: @crucible/schemas
description: The shipped Crucible OpenSpec change-type bundles (crucible / crucible-bugfix / crucible-refactor). Plain files installed by copying; `crucible init` copies them into a target repo's openspec/schemas/.
//: The built core CLI loads this package under plain Node in consumer CI, so its runtime export is dist/index.js. The bundle DATA lives under crucible*/; src/index.ts only computes paths — it never parses or mutates the bundles (that is core's changetype/ TCB).
